datasets.name: JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater dataset
datasets.verbatim: the max-extent band from the JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater dataset (Pekel et al., 2016) were used to mask pixels representing water and hill shadows, respectively.

datasets.name: HR-GLDD dataset
datasets.verbatim: This evaluation was performed on the advertised HR-GLDD (collection 1) dataset (Meena et al. 2023).

methods.name: MSFAM-ResAttUnet
methods.summary: A multispectral landslide segmentation network that integrates a Feature Attention Module (FAM) into a ResAttUnet backbone. It uses a dual-branch architecture to process nine spectral bands and topographic inputs, with the FAM prioritizing landslide features to minimize information loss during downsampling.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory (MRGSLD) and custom code (MSFAM-ResAttUnet) are linked via a persistent Zenodo repository. Other input datasets are accessible through public platforms like Google Earth Engine or are referenced as established public datasets.
